newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE HOLDS FIRST 1997 SESSION.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE HOLDS FIRST 1997 SESSION.

text.p: Turnover amounted to 290,270 denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Traded volume was 361 shares as Alkaloid joint stock company sold 261 shares at 1,070 denars, unchanged from last trading and below par of 2,423 denars.
A total of 100 Oteks shares traded at 110 denars against last close of 130 denars and a par of 1,941 denars
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday.
